text:
toni: Quick note 1: I'm prepping a docs patch for Dedicated: add C# + Scala SDK snippets, tighten isolation wording, and fix a handful of anchors. Will rename `max_batches` -> `max_concurrent_batches` and `burst_limit` -> `burst_capacity` in examples.

pras: I can do the C# snippet and a short migration blurb. Should we recommend `isolation_level: strict` for compliance customers?

hannah: Yes recommend strict for regulated flows. Also suggest we stop using the word 'eviction' and use 'preemption' everywhere. I'll review the SLA table language.

devex-bot: preview-lint: code blocks require language tags; migration frontmatter needed when config names change.

link-bot: link-checker: dedicated/provisioning.md -> broken anchor at line 230: `#capacityPreempt` (camelCase). Suggested anchor: `#capacity-preemption`.

toni: thanks bots. I'll patch anchors and add redirects from old anchors. PR draft incoming.

pras: C# snippet draft (will include language tag):
```csharp
// create a scale policy with concurrency and isolation
var policy = new ScalePolicy {
  Name = "csharp-burst",
  MaxConcurrentBatches = 10, // was max_batches
  TargetLatencyMs = 100,
  IsolationLevel = IsolationLevel.Balanced
};
await client.Dedicated.CreateScalePolicyAsync(policy);
```
I'll include migration note for field mapping and a short cost example.

hannah: Scala snippet I'll add to the examples page:
```scala
val policy = ScalePolicy(
  name = "scala-steady",
  maxConcurrentBatches = 6,
  targetLatencyMs = 150,
  isolationLevel = "balanced"
)
client.dedicated.createScalePolicy(policy)
```
Also adding an SLA sentence: "Burst capacity is opportunistic and not covered by baseline SLA; under strict isolation preemption may route to pinned fallback models."

toni: PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512. Tagged @hannah and @pras for review.

pras: small ask: add a short CLI example too if possible, and note that strict isolation disables burst by default.

hannah: will do final pass on wording. If we change anchors, let's bump internal crosslinks in the overview page so no 404s.

devex-bot: preview build: branch -> warnings: missing language tag on one code block (fixed after update). Lint rule: use US English spelling for 'behavior'.

toni: aiming to merge today. After merge I'll update the Dedicated migration checklist and ping support + release for the console copy updates. :thumbsup:
